messages:
kevin: Heads-up — ACME renewal discussion tomorrow. They want to convert their pay-as-you-go to a 12mo committed private offer. Thoughts on discount bands and renewal escalators?
alia: Good. We should align on marketplace SKU pricing vs private offer. For Commit < $100k => ~12% off, $100k-$500k => ~20%, > $500k => ~28% (very rough). Need legal on escalator clauses.
maria: Agree on bands but don't hardcode %s in the playbook. Also need to factor hardware credits for Dedicated customers (NVIDIA partner credits). If they move to Dedicated we should offer a VM+GPU uplift rebate instead of a flat discount.
samir: +1. Also add an early renewal bonus (e.g., 60-day invoice credit) to avoid procurement delays. Structure as a one-time credit applied to the first invoice after renewal.
alia: For marketplace private offers procurement expects invoiceable commitments. We need a SKU mapping doc for AWS/Azure so Sales Ops can tie the PO to our billing. Can Eng-Ops produce a simple mapping CSV?
kevin: I'll ping Eng-Ops. @partners-bot can you attach the latest SKU mapping?
partners-bot: attached: marketplaces_sku_map_v3.csv
maria: Also coordinate with SIs — they often upsell services at renewal. Proposal: allow a 5% uplift to channel partner commission if they bring a services SOW at renewal (incentivize SI-led migrations to Dedicated).
samir: Legal flag: include price-protection language — if our list price drops during the committed term, we offer a one-time adjustment applied at renewal only (no mid-term retroactive credits). OK?
maria: Fine. Need a Renewal Playbook with steps: 1) Alert at 90/60/30 days, 2) Partner readiness check (SOW/infra), 3) Draft private-offer with SKU IDs, credits, commission uplift, 4) Legal review, 5) Customer sign + PO, 6) Apply credits and update billing.
alia: I'll convert that into a Notion checklist and add internal templates: (a) private-offer term sheet, (b) renewal email cadence, (c) SKU mapping sample.
kevin: Action items: @alia create Notion checklist & templates, @kevin request SKU mapping from Eng-Ops, @maria loop in SI leads & hardware partners, @samir get Legal alignment on price protection and escalators. Review sync next Tue 11am. :thumbsup:
